items.title: Mittag-Leffler along a short exact sequence of inverse systems with essentially constant quotient
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file homology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that in a short exact sequence of inverse systems of abelian groups with essentially constant quotient, the Mittag-Leffler property holds for the sub-system if and only if it holds for the middle system (statement lines 7977-7986). The proof is a complete argument: the hypothesis is put into normal form using the cited lemma (proof lines 7989-7991), the case of a zero constant part is settled by comparing the systems of images of the two sub-diagrams (proof lines 7993-8003), and the general case is reduced to that one by replacing the middle system by the inverse image of the constant part, after which a short exact sequence of image systems finishes the argument (proof lines 8005-8018). The non-formal content is the comparison of the two image systems. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each input named.
